name: Shandong Extreme Vision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Extreme Vision Technology Co., Ltd. engages in delivering end-to-end solution development, deployment, and management services in China. It offers AI computer vision solution, a technological solution that simulates the human visual system to enable computers to extract information from images or videos and analyze, make decisions and interact based on this information; and Large model solution that refers to applications built on the functionality of large models, as well as the related supporting services.
